captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a single protective soft jaw designed to slip over a standard metal vise jaw. It is a long, rectangular block featuring a deep, rectangular pocket on its backside to securely fit over the existing vise jaw. The front clamping face is flat, while the interior pocket includes recessed cylindrical cavities on the bottom surface intended for holding mounting magnets.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric soft jaw for a vise that fits over the existing metal jaws. The script should allow customization of the vise jaw's width and height, the wall and face thicknesses, the depth of the surrounding lip, and include parameters for embedding holding magnets and optional V-groove guides for holding round stock.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main difference block. A solid outer rectangular cube is created first, and a second, smaller cube is subtracted from it to form the main pocket for the vise jaw. A for-loop is used inside the first difference to subtract cylindrical cavities for the mounting magnets. A second outer difference loop cuts angled V-grooves into the clamping face by rotating and translating long, low-resolution cylinders (acting as square prisms with $fn=4) along the length of the jaw.
